description: Farms AND coordination points (farmers' markets, off-farm pickup points, stockists) within a radius of a point or a named place, ordered by distance, optionally filtered by what is sold (species ids or a good slug), a farming practice, a service category, or an event type. Points carry their schedule and the farms present. Distances are straight-line from each farm's PUBLIC map point, or pass distance="road" for cached driving distance + minutes (cold pairs are filled once per call, capped). This is the "where can I get X near here — and where on Saturday" primitive.

distance.description: straight (default) = geodesic from the public point. road = driving km + minutes from the shared 90-day cache; a bounded number of cold pairs are routed fresh per call, the rest carry straight-line only until warmed. Maps-hidden farms never carry road figures.

event_types.description: event type slugs from list_filters, e.g. ["berry-picking"].

good.description: A goods slug from list_goods (e.g. "grass-fed-beef") — expands to its species and practice scope.

include.description: What to return: farms, points (markets / pickups / stockists), or both (default).

lat.description: Latitude of the centre. Pass lat+lng OR place.

limit.description: Results per page, applied to farms and points separately (default 25).

place.description: A place slug from list_places, e.g. "calgary", "alberta/calgary" or "alberta". Its centroid becomes the centre and its reach the default radius.

practices.description: farming practice ids from list_filters, e.g. ["rotationalGrazing"].

radius_km.description: Search radius in km (default: the place's reach, else 50; max 300).

service_categories.description: service category slugs from list_filters, e.g. ["hay-feed-forage"].

species.description: species ids (from search_farmdex / get_place_catalogue), OR-matched, e.g. ["cattle-taurus"].

name: find_near
